implemented.opportunity: Retention calculator introductory and subsequent monthly prices
implemented.evidence: The original calculator multiplied a single monthly price by the whole term. Vodacom contract terms section 5.1 also distinguishes service discounts from the full subscription price.
implemented.calculation: introductory monthly price times introductory months, plus normal monthly price times remaining months, plus once-off costs; switching also includes old-account settlement
implemented.checks: Flat pricing, free introductory months, full-term promotion, cents, invalid terms, finite amounts, settlement and browser comparison readiness.
implemented.dateBoundary: Calculator/editorial modification is 12 October. Existing legal/contract overview source review stays 19 July; a note explains the partial update.

implemented.evidence: A new mathematical tool using reader-entered prices and allowances. No operator prices are assumed.
implemented.calculation: Both paths fulfil identical demand on identical active days. Each purchase keeps its own fixed-day expiry; balances are consumed in expiry order, and sufficient whole bundles are bought only when needed.
implemented.checks: Small allowances, early depletion, expiry boundaries, sparse days, late first use, duplicate days, decimal GB boundaries, invalid input, reset, zero usage and repeat-purchase confirmation.
implemented.limits: One-day daily bundles, fixed-day longer validity, constant usage per active day, no automatic renewals or expiry extensions. Reader confirms repeat purchases and concurrent bundles. Worked example is hypothetical.

implemented.sourceAccess: TFG home and subscriber terms were read in a JavaScript-capable browser; Bash terms were opened through the research reader. All checked 12 October.
implemented.verifiedTerms: Subscriber terms V7 dated 5 February 2025: 2.1.9 identifies MTN; 2.1.12 and 2.1.16 distinguish prepaid from monthly Top Up; 4 covers cancellation; 6.2 and 6.3 cover advance billing and possible account interest; 7.1 excludes MTN/other provider recharge vouchers; 13 preserves original expiry on transferred data.
implemented.scope: Editorial profile and verified payment choices in the chooser. No tracker rows, host-network registry entries, tariff rankings or conditional reward values are added.
implemented.limits: Prepaid prices, exact TymeBank discount, rollover and eSIM availability remain unverified. The homepage showed monthly subscription prices, but they have not been imported into the tracker.

held.decision: Keep the existing conflict disclosure and all saved prices/source dates. No factual correction is supported.
